CatLiveLame.dll: LAME 3.100 encoder, LGPL 2 or later.
The encoder sources are unmodified. The included config.h is the CatLive MSVC x64 build configuration (no assembly or MP3 decoder).
Full upstream source is included in lame-3.100-source.tar.gz; COPYING contains the license.
To rebuild a compatible replacement with MSVC and CMake, extract the archive and create a CMake project using:

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(CatLiveLame LANGUAGES C)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
set(root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lame-3.100")
set(names bitstream encoder fft gain_analysis id3tag lame newmdct presets psymodel quantize quantize_pvt reservoir set_get tables takehiro util vbrquantize VbrTag version)
foreach(name IN LISTS names)
    list(APPEND sources "${root}/libmp3lame/${name}.c")
endforeach()
add_library(CatLiveLame SHARED ${sources})
set_target_properties(CatLiveLame PROPERTIES WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)
target_include_directories(CatLiveLame PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${root}/include" "${root}/libmp3lame")
target_compile_definitions(CatLiveLame PRIVATE HAVE_CONFIG_H _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)

Put the included config.h beside this CMakeLists.txt, then:
cmake -S . -B build -A x64
cmake --build build --config Release

Close CatLive and replace CatLiveLame.dll beside CatLive.exe with build/Release/CatLiveLame.dll.
The application does not restrict replacement of this library. Reverse engineering for debugging modifications to this LGPL library is permitted.
